notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Added auto save after completing a level in bossrush.
[*]Added option to continue from the main menu if there's a save present. Loaded files are ineligible for leaderboards and achievements.
[/list]
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Completing a level with one character now allows it to be played in level select with all characters.	
[*]Weapons have had their default damage boosted slightly.
[*]Bullets fired while time is stopped have had their damage boosted considerably.
[*]Time is stopped for a little longer.
[*]Lowered the boss's health in level 8
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with falling through the floor in level 8.	
[*]Removed a leftover debug feature.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10
notes.notes:
[h1]Bugfixes/Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed score achievement not appearing. If you qualify it should activate when you start the game now.
[*]Added 100% achievement for earning all badges.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.notes:
[h1]Bugfixes/Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with some controller thumbsticks not being recognized.
[*]Thumbsticks are now slightly less sensitive in game and menus.
[*]Fixed being unable to proceed if you die during level 8 bonus.
[/list]
